title: Old-ST Event-Handler Service Generator
description: Scaffold an SQS-consumer event-handler microservice (apps/{domain}/{domain}-event-handler-service). No HTTP layer, no Swagger, no presentation folder.

domain.description: Owning domain in kebab-case (e.g. notification, order). The service will live at apps/{domain}/{domain}-event-handler-service.
domain.x-prompt: What is the owning domain (kebab-case, e.g. notification)?

entity.description: Entity name in kebab-case (default: same as domain). Drives the dispatcher/module file names.

eventTypes.description: Comma-separated event types in CONSTANT_CASE (e.g. USER_DELETED,USER_DEACTIVATED). One handler stub will be generated per event type.
eventTypes.x-prompt: Which event types? (comma-separated CONSTANT_CASE, e.g. USER_DELETED,USER_DEACTIVATED)

crossDomain.description: If true, this handler consumes events published by a different bounded context. Dispatcher imports schemas from `@old-st/contracts/{sourceDomain}` and handlers must use Extract<...DomainEvent, {eventType:'X'}> for typing.

sourceDomain.description: Required when crossDomain=true. The publishing domain (kebab-case) whose events we consume.
